paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.16% on average, with DAX strongest (+1.31%) and Nasdaq weakest (-1.44%). Brent crude changed -4.16% to 110.52. Gold changed -0.42% to 4,034.6001. Bitcoin changed -0.36% to 80,978.1719. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.007%, a relative move of -0.75%. Among the firms tracked, Rio Tinto (-4.88%) and Deutsche Bank (+4.00%) moved the most.
